summary: Delixy Holdings Ltd filed Form 6-K reporting board changes. Two independent directors resigned effective July 29, 2026, with no disagreement noted, and two new independent directors were appointed July 30, 2026. Committees were reconstituted. This is a routine board refresh, not a forced departure or strategic event, so categorization is borderline; however, the resignations and appointments are the sole subject of the filing, thus treated as a management change with medium confidence.
